bear.point: EBITDA margin fell to 15.8% from 18.5%, missing the 22–24% medium-term target.
EBITDA margin at 15.6% trails the 20.5–21.2% FY27 guidance, indicating execution slippage.
PAT declined 28.4% YoY despite 6.5% revenue growth, showing severe operating leverage erosion.
Persistent European automotive weakness threatens the recovery timeline, risking further demand delays.

bull.point: Operating cash flow at 1.65× PAT over FY22–FY26 ensures high quality earnings.
Solutions and products revenue grew 25% YoY, partially meeting the 30% FY27 target.
Debt/equity of 0.24 remains low, preserving balance sheet flexibility for investments.
Management expects H2 FY27 revenue to exceed H1, returning to growth by Q4.
